m1.typescript: m1 a failed call becomes a structured error with a category a retry flag and an error flag

e1.typescript: e1 a generic message or an unknown category is refused

e2.typescript: e2 only transient failures are retried with growing waits and the other kinds return at once

e3.typescript: e3 the retries are bounded and a wait the service asks for is honoured

e4.typescript: e4 a valid empty result is a success and not an error

e5.typescript: e5 a timeout on a write is an unknown outcome and is retried only when repeating it is safe

e6.typescript: e6 the next action follows the category

e7.typescript: e7 an unexpected exception becomes an internal error and the run goes on

wrong-flag-missing.defect: reports a failed call as a tool result without the error flag

wrong-business-retryable.defect: marks a business rule violation as worth retrying

wrong-generic-message.defect: accepts a message such as Operation failed

wrong-unknown-kind-accepted.defect: accepts a category that is not one of the six

wrong-retries-validation.defect: retries a call that failed validation

wrong-flat-wait.defect: waits the same time before every retry

wrong-extra-retry.defect: makes one attempt more than the retry limit allows

wrong-ignores-retry-after.defect: sleeps its own backoff when the service named a wait

wrong-empty-is-error.defect: reports a valid empty result as a failure

wrong-timeout-retried.defect: retries a timed out write that has no key

wrong-key-dropped.defect: leaves the idempotency key out of the arguments it retries with

wrong-mutates-args.defect: writes the idempotency key into the caller's own arguments

wrong-permission-retry-later.defect: tells the loop to retry later after a permission error

wrong-internal-retryable.defect: marks an unexpected failure as retryable

wrong-internal-no-detail.defect: leaves the exception's message out of the internal error
